notes: Shopify storefront (nicobar.com), robots.txt allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow - used direct HTTP fetch (collections.json, products.json?limit=250, homepage HTML nav dump) throughout; Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome not needed. Scoped to Home (non-apparel): main nav's 'Home & Living' mega-menu links exactly one Bestsellers PLP for Home - /collections/home-bestsellers ('Home Bestsellers', live since 2021-04-17) - confirmed by homepage HTML href scan and by search/suggest.json. Verified via products.json?limit=250 exhaustive enumeration (115 products, all Home-vertical product_types: Coffee & Tea Sets, Serveware, Plates, Decor, Barware, Bowls, Candle & Oil Warmers, Home Fragrance, Blankets, Photo Frame, Cushions, Vases, Lantern - no apparel/jewelry contamination). Enumerated the full collections.json catalog (1247 collections across 5 pages) and site search/suggest.json for 'bestseller' to check for other Home-scoped bestseller PLPs: found two orphan candidates NOT linked anywhere in current main nav/header/footer (checked via full-text grep of homepage HTML) - (1) /collections/our-home-accessories, on-page title 'Our Bestsellers', created 2020-12-14 (i.e. before home-bestsellers existed, 2021-04-17) - only 14 products with just 5/14 overlapping home-bestsellers, reads as the superseded/legacy precursor of the current Home Bestsellers page, not a live separate concept; (2) /collections/the-best-of-home, on-page H1 'THE BEST OF HOME', created 2023-01-26, 11 products, generic marketing body copy ('Make everyday living special with Nicobar's consciously crafted homeware') with no bestseller/popularity signal in its own copy or breadcrumb - reads as an editorial 'best of' curation page, not a site-defined Bestsellers merchandising concept, and is unreachable from any live navigation path. Both excluded as not genuinely exposed by the site's current taxonomy (same treatment as retired/orphan PDPs in the prior Home-Decor pass's notes/269.md). Other bestseller collections found in the full catalog (bestseller/bestseller-1 'Women/general Bestseller', men-bestsellers, jewellery-bestsellers, our-bestsellers-accessories, our-bestsellers-jewellery, our-bestsellers-men, our-bestsellers-women, seasons-men/women-bestseller) are all apparel/jewelry/accessory scoped per their own titles and nav placement - out of scope per task instruction to scope strictly to home decor. No sub-structure (e.g. 'Kitchen Bestsellers' / 'Decor Bestsellers') is exposed by the site for Home - only one undifferentiated Home Bestsellers listing exists, so sub_category equals the site's own listing name rather than inventing children.
